title: pentanema maletii
intro: Pentanema maletii, commonly known as Indian fleabane, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Pentanema maletii are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which can contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pentanema maletii include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
